The '''Tyne Albamon system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Rseik sector/Legends|Rseik sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tyne Albamon]].<ref name="TEAOC" />
